verification_results.my_quotes_message_btn_uses_button_naviga: uses navigate(`/messages?job=${q.job_id}&to=${q.job_posted_by_id}`) — button not anchor, so href attribute is null by design

observations_and_minor_findings: BrowseJobsPage fetches only /api/jobs?status=open page 1 (20 items). pro@test.com has 4 pending quotes — all 4 are on pages 2–3 of the open-jobs list (verified via API: pages 1–4 total=70). Implementation of applied-badge/view-quote is CORRECT (logic at BrowseJobsPage.jsx:142-167 + ExpandableJobCard wiring is right; verified that backend /api/quotes returns those 4 job_ids with status=open). UI just doesn't surface them because there's no pagination control on the BrowseJobsPage. Not a regression — just a UX limitation worth a follow-up in a future iter.

/my-quotes Message button is a <button onClick={navigate(...)}> rather than <Link>, so it has no href attribute. The spec wording says 'links to' which is satisfied semantically; only mention if main agent prefers <Link to=...> for accessibility / middle-click open.
action_items: (optional, low-priority) Add pagination controls to /browse-jobs so pros can navigate to pages 2+ where their applied jobs may live — this would surface the applied-badge/view-quote testids in the UI for pro@test.com (currently 0 of 4 pending-quote jobs visible on page 1).
(optional, nit) Consider replacing the my-quote-job-*-message <button onClick={navigate}> with a react-router <Link to> to give it a real href (helps middle-click-to-new-tab + a11y).
critical_code_review_comments: quote_routes.py:170-206 — list_my_quotes enrichment is correct and economical (single jobs.find_one per quote). Could be batched with $in lookup for ~45 quotes (latency O(n) DB calls) but not blocking.
message_routes.py:98-115 — clean elif branch exposes own pro_id when current_user_role == 'tradesperson'. Verified via curl: returns pro's OWN profile_id + availability.
ExpandableJobCard.jsx (~115 lines) — clean reusable component, correct testid prefix scheme (browse-job-{id}-toggle/body/attach-{file_id} and my-quote-job-{id}-toggle/body/attach-{file_id}).
MonthBookingCalendar.jsx readOnly + bookings props correctly hide confirm button (visible=false confirmed via Playwright bbox=None) and paint cal-slot-* with data-booked='true' + red strikethrough.
InboxPage.jsx re-fetches /api/pros/{pro_id}/bookings after bookSlot — verified by AFTER=3 (delta +1) within 3.5s, no manual reload.

BrowseJobsPage.jsx has no pagination — only fetches /api/jobs?status=open page=1 (20 items). Not a blocker for iter16 but blocks visual verification of applied-badge for pro@test.com whose 4 pending-quote jobs are on later pages.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (8/8 iter16 acceptance criteria; minor pagination caveat noted)
